hero.bodyP1: Checking your 7/12 extract, finding exact plot borders, or verifying ownership papers shouldn't take three trips to the Taluka office.
hero.bodyP2: BhoomiSetu links your registry papers, cadastral map lines, and revenue records in one simple dashboard - sign in to search, verify, and manage the parcels linked to your account.
nav.brandTagline: One land, many records - BhoomiSetu connects them
citizenPortal.profileContactDesc: Add or change your email and mobile number. A change only takes effect once you verify the new value.
authPage.accountExistsEmailError: An account is already registered with this email address. Please sign in instead.
authPage.accountExistsMobileError: An account is already registered with this mobile number. Please sign in instead.
raiseRequestPage.linkParcelButton: Link a Parcel to Get Started
aiChat.intro: Describe your land-related issue and I'll help you file a formal case.
about.feature0Desc: Find a plot by ULPIN, survey number, plot number, or a local identifier on an interactive map.
about.feature1Desc: Ownership, registration, land use, tax status, restrictions, disputes, encumbrances and ownership history - all in one 360° view.
about.feature2Desc: Check a land document against the official record in seconds, instead of visiting multiple offices.
about.feature3Desc: Describe your land issue in your own words and get a formal application drafted and routed to the right department.
about.feature4Desc: Follow every request you raise, from submission to resolution, on a clear timeline.
about.feature5Desc: Schedule in-person visits with the relevant department when your case needs original documents.
about.feature6Desc: The portal and the AI assistant work in multiple Indian languages.
about.feature7Desc: Get updates on your parcels, requests and case decisions.
auth.demoAccountsPasswordNote: All demo accounts use the password
auth.otpVerifiedSuccessDesc: One more step - enter the code we sent to confirm your {{method}}.
citizen.searchDesc: Type your 14-digit Bhu-Aadhaar, survey number, or plot number to pull up ownership and mutation status.
citizen.mapDesc: Click directly on any plot outline on the map to see boundary coordinates, area in hectares, and road connectivity.
citizen.verifyDesc: Upload a clear photo or PDF of your registered sale deed or 7/12 extract. We check if the owner names and plot numbers match government records.
placeholders.landClaimDesc: Already found your plot in the records? Search for it below and claim it - an officer reviews and approves each claim before it's linked to your account.
placeholders.profileDesc: Manage your phone number, address, and account details - coming soon.
placeholders.notificationsDesc: A per-department notification feed (received, under review, approved, rejected, info requested) is on its way. Until then, check a request's status on the Requests page.
citizenPortal.raiseRequestDesc: Choose one of your parcels to file a service request against it. Your parcel's details are filled in automatically.
citizenPortal.raiseRequestParcelPlacehol: Choose a parcel linked to your account
citizenPortal.raiseRequestNoParcels: No parcels are linked to your account yet, so there's nothing to raise a request against. Visit My Parcels once one is linked.
adminPortal.movedToSystemMonitoring: Recent activity and system health moved to the System Monitoring page.
onboarding.tour.dashboardDesc: Return here any time for an overview of your land records and requests.
onboarding.tour.findDesc: Search by ULPIN, survey number or district, and locate parcels on the GIS map.
onboarding.tour.parcelsDesc: Open a parcel to view its records, ownership and documents.
onboarding.tour.casesDesc: Submitted requests and their current status appear here.
onboarding.tour.assistanceDesc: Need help? Find guides and support here - and replay this tour any time.
onboarding.tour.notificationsDesc: Updates on your requests and records show up here.
onboarding.tour.profileDesc: Manage your details, contact methods, documents and language here.
